site.name: notion
site.summary: notion-clone Clone of the Notion marketing funnel: home + product sub-pages + templates + pricing. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Home: top nav (Product / Download / Solutions / Resources / Pricing / Request demo / Log in / Get Notion free), hero section (product positioning + CTA + main screenshot), modular product intros (Docs / Wikis / Projects / AI), customer logo wall, customer stories, multi-column footer | | `projects.html` | Project management sub-page: feature highlights, view-switching screenshots (Board / Timeline / Calendar), case studies, CTA | | `wikis.html` | Wiki sub-page: knowledge-base examples, permissions / search / template features, CTA |

run_plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the Notion marketing funnel across its primary landing flow and adjacent product pages, emphasizing interactive controls, conversions (free/demo), and mobile usability.
run_plan.summary: Start on index.html and validate the global navigation and primary conversion actions (Get Notion free, Request a demo) plus in-page CTAs (e.g., See pricing plans). Then traverse each adjacent top-nav page (Projects, Wikis, Templates, Pricing) and exercise their key interactive elements (view switches, FAQ toggles, buttons/links). Finish by repeating the critical flows on mobile viewport and sanity-checking any modal/dialog behavior from demo/signup CTAs.
assumptions: The site is a static marketing funnel using local HTML files with client-side JS interactions (evidenced by multiple href='javascript:void(0)' and prescan indicating dialogs/forms).
Global nav links route to the five known pages: index.html, projects.html, wikis.html, templates-projects.html, pricing.html.
At least some CTAs (Request a demo / Get Notion free) open an in-page dialog or trigger a form flow, since the prescan counts dialogs and forms on pages.
risk_hotspots: index.html: 'Request a demo' and 'Get Notion free' use href='javascript:void(0)'—risk of non-functional click, missing dialog close/reset, or focus traps (mobile especially).
pricing.html: yearly/monthly toggle ('Toggle yearly pricing')—risk of pricing cards not updating, wrong selection persistence, or broken CTA bindings after toggling.

pricing.html: FAQ accordion buttons (e.g., 'How does Notion AI use my data?', 'What are your accepted payment methods?', 'What is a block?')—risk of multiple-open behavior or missing accessibility/state updates.
templates-projects.html: FAQ buttons list (multiple questions as discrete buttons)—risk of overlapping UI, scroll-jump issues, or incorrect answer panel association.
projects.html: view-switching screenshots mentioned in prescan (Board/Timeline/Calendar) though not listed as explicit interactables—risk of controls being images/buttons with weak tap targets.
Cross-site: top nav items and footer links—prescan flags many 'small_tap_target' warnings, so mobile hit-area usability is a likely issue.

phases.title: Index landing: navigation + primary conversion paths
phases.objective: Validate the core landing-page UX: top navigation routing, primary CTAs, and key in-page links to adjacent product pages and pricing.
key_checks: Click top-nav items: Projects, Wikis, Templates, Pricing; confirm correct page loads and active state/scroll position.
Trigger 'Request a demo' (href javascript:void(0)); verify a dialog/form appears (or clear feedback if not available) and can be dismissed/closed.
Trigger 'Get Notion free' (href javascript:void(0)); verify dialog/form or navigation response; confirm any entered/returned state is consistent.
Use in-page CTA 'See pricing plans →' to navigate to pricing.html and confirm scroll/anchor behavior.
Click 'Knowledge Base' in the lower page section to verify routing to wikis.html.
exit_criteria: All five top-nav routes successfully load their target pages without errors.
At least one 'Request a demo' interaction and one 'Get Notion free' interaction are validated end-to-end (dialog appears, is dismissible, no broken state).
In-page CTAs/links correctly navigate to their intended adjacent pages (pricing and wikis).

phases.title: Product subpages: Projects + Wikis feature comprehension and CTAs
phases.objective: Exercise the primary content sections and interactive elements on each subpage, focusing on conversion CTAs and any feature toggles/search/permissions UI mentioned in headings.
key_checks: Projects page: locate and interact with the view-switching controls for project views (Board / Timeline / Calendar) if present; confirm screenshot/content swaps.
Projects page: find 'Get Notion free' or other CTA links/buttons on the page and validate their behavior (dialog/form or routing consistent with index).

Wikis page: scan for any interactive elements tied to 'Search that actually works', 'Drag and drop organization', 'Synced Blocks' and 'Verification'—attempt the most obvious UI controls and confirm they respond.
Wikis page: click Knowledge Base/Projects CTAs in-page (e.g., links leading to other sections) and ensure routing works.
exit_criteria: Projects page view-switching (Board/Timeline/Calendar) is confirmed working or clearly absent (no dead controls).
Both Projects and Wikis pages have at least one CTA/button tested for functional response.
Any visible interactive feature demos on Projects/Wikis respond with correct UI state changes (no stuck overlays).

phases.title: Templates + Pricing: FAQ/toggles and conversion clarity
phases.objective: Validate the heaviest interaction areas: pricing billing toggle, FAQ accordions, and templates-page FAQ buttons; confirm CTAs align with selected plan context.
key_checks: Templates page: click each visible FAQ/button (e.g., 'Is Notion good for project management?', 'Can I manage Agile projects in Notion?', etc.); verify the corresponding answer panel/section expands and collapses correctly.
Templates page: click 'Request a demo' and 'Get Notion free' CTAs on-page; ensure behavior matches index (dialog/form lifecycle).
Pricing page: toggle yearly/monthly pricing ('Toggle yearly pricing') and verify plan card prices update correctly and persist when scrolling.

Pricing page: click each FAQ accordion button ('How does Notion AI use my data?', 'What are your accepted payment methods?', 'What is a block?', 'How is pricing calculated...'); verify accordion state updates and no multiple sections conflict unexpectedly.
Pricing page: click 'Sign up' and 'Get started' for at least two plan tiers; verify correct CTA response (including whether a plan-specific context is passed to the signup/demo flow).
Pricing page: test 'Contact Sales' path to confirm form/dialog appears and can be dismissed.
exit_criteria: All visible FAQ buttons on templates-projects.html show correct expanded/collapsed content associations.
Pricing yearly/monthly toggle updates pricing UI reliably without stale values.
At least two plan CTAs and Contact Sales are validated as functional with appropriate dialog/page response.

phases.title: Mobile regression: hit-targets + critical flow re-check
phases.objective: Repeat the most important actions on mobile viewport to catch tap-target and responsive layout issues flagged by prescan (many controls below 44px).
key_checks: On mobile viewport, tap the top-nav items (Projects/Wikis/Templates/Pricing) and confirm the tap targets register and navigation works.
On mobile, tap 'Request a demo' and 'Get Notion free' on index; verify dialogs/forms open, remain usable, and close reliably.
On mobile, toggle yearly pricing and open at least one pricing FAQ accordion; confirm accordion and toggle remain usable and readable.
On mobile, test at least one plan CTA ('Sign up' or 'Get started') to ensure it’s reachable and functional.
exit_criteria: No critical CTA (demo/free/signup) fails on mobile; dialogs are operable and dismissible.
Key toggles (pricing billing + FAQ) work reliably on mobile.
Tap targets are confirmed workable for navigation and CTAs despite 'small_tap_target' warnings.

coverage_targets.pages: visit all known HTML pages (index.html, projects.html, wikis.html, templates-projects.html, pricing.html)
coverage_targets.features: exercise most visible controls per key page: index CTAs (Request a demo, Get Notion free, See pricing plans), Projects view switching (Board/Timeline/Calendar), Wikis interactive feature demos (search/drag/drop/blocks/verification as available), Templates FAQ buttons, Pricing billing toggle + FAQ accordions + plan CTAs
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat critical checks (navigation, demo/free, pricing toggle, at least one FAQ and one plan CTA) on mobile viewport

notes: Prescan indicates multiple dialogs/forms but not their exact fields; when dialogs open, validate: keyboard/tap focus usability, close behavior, and that re-opening does not create broken/duplicated UI.
Many nav and CTA elements may have small hit areas; mobile phase should record whether any intended taps miss or require precision.

Yes. Teams use Notion to manage plans, tasks, timelines, docs, and status updates in one place. Because templates are composable, you can tailor workflows without duct-taping multiple tools together. What project management templates should I start with? Start with a project plan, timeline (Gantt), WBS, RACI, and a weekly status report. These cover the four fundamentals: scope, schedule, ownership, and communication. Can I manage Agile projects in Notion? Yes. Use a backlog and sprint board (Kanban), plus a timeline for capacity planning. Add retrospectives and a change log to complete the loop. What does "composable project management" mean? It's the idea of building your system from modular parts that can be reconfigured as needs change. Your project management tool, built by you, for you. Does Notion support templates for different industries? Yes, Notion offers project templates for various industries, from software and marketing to construction and educ

observation.title: Notion Pricing – Free, Plus, Business, & Enterprise
observation.visible_text: Notion Projects Wikis Templates Pricing Request a demo Get Notion free One tool to run your company. Trusted by teams at OpenAI Figma Volvo Ramp Cursor Monthly Yearly Save up to 20% Free $0 per member / month For individuals to organize personal projects and life. Sign up Includes: Trial of Notion AI Basic forms Basic sites Notion Calendar Notion Mail (Syncs with Gmail) Databases with subtasks, dependencies, custom properties Plus $10 per member / month For small teams and professionals to work together. Get started Everything in Free, and: Trial of Notion AI Custom forms Custom sites Unlimited charts Unlimited collaborative blocks Unlimited file uploads Basic integrations Business $20 per member / month For growing businesses to streamline teamwork. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Contact Sales Everything in Business, and: Zero data retention with LLM providers User provisioning (SCIM) Advanced security & controls Audit log Customer success manager Security & Compliance integrations Domain management Advanced integrations Plans and features Free Plus Business Enterprise Content Pages & blocks Limited Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited File uploads Up to 5 MB Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Page history 7 days 30 days 90 days Unlimited Verify any page — — ✓ ✓ Offline ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Sharing & collaboration External guest limit 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Teamspaces (open & closed) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Teamspaces (private) — — ✓ ✓ Granular database permissions — — ✓ ✓ Notion AI AI Core (chat, generate, autofill) Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Meeting Notes Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Enterprise Search — — ✓ ✓ Notion Agent Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Custom Agents — — Credits Credits Admin & security SAML SSO — — ✓ ✓ User provisioning (SCIM) — — — ✓ Audit log — — — ✓ Advanced security controls — — — ✓ Questions & answers How does Notion AI use my data? Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle. observation.title: Notion Pricing – Free, Plus, Business, & Enterprise
observation.visible_text: Notion One tool to run your company. Trusted by teams at OpenAI Figma Volvo Ramp Cursor Monthly Yearly Save up to 20% Free $0 per member / month For individuals to organize personal projects and life. Sign up Includes: Trial of Notion AI Basic forms Basic sites Notion Calendar Notion Mail (Syncs with Gmail) Databases with subtasks, dependencies, custom properties Plus $10 per member / month For small teams and professionals to work together. Get started Everything in Free, and: Trial of Notion AI Custom forms Custom sites Unlimited charts Unlimited collaborative blocks Unlimited file uploads Basic integrations Business $20 per member / month For growing businesses to streamline teamwork. Get started Everything in Plus, and: Notion Agent AI Meeting Notes Enterprise Search SAML SSO Granular database permissions Verify any page Private teamspaces Premium integrations Enterprise Custom pricing For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security. Contact Sales Everything in Business, and: Zero data retention with LLM providers User provisioning (SCIM) Advanced security & controls Audit log Customer success manager Security & Compliance integrations Domain management Advanced integrations Plans and features Free Plus Business Enterprise Content Pages & blocks Limited Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited File uploads Up to 5 MB Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Page history 7 days 30 days 90 days Unlimited Verify any page — — ✓ ✓ Offline ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Sharing & collaboration External guest limit 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Teamspaces (open & closed) ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Teamspaces (private) — — ✓ ✓ Granular database permissions — — ✓ ✓ Notion AI AI Core (chat, generate, autofill) Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Meeting Notes Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Enterprise Search — — ✓ ✓ Notion Agent Trial Trial ✓ ✓ Custom Agents — — Credits Credits Admin & security SAML SSO — — ✓ ✓ User provisioning (SCIM) — — — ✓ Audit log — — — ✓ Advanced security controls — — — ✓ Questions & answers How does Notion AI use my data? Notion follows standard data protection practices to keep your data encrypted and private. Notion AI will not use your data to train models unless you opt in. AI subprocessors are contractually prohibited from using customer data for training. What are your accepted payment methods? Notion currently accepts all major credit and debit card brands. What is a block? A block is any single piece of content you add to your page, like a paragraph of text, a to-do item, an image, a code block, an embedded file, etc. Think of your page as being made up of these building blocks. How is pricing calculated for the paid plans? If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member. Guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to. Do you offer student discounts? The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators. Just sign up with your school email address and you'll immediately gain access to these features. How do refunds work? If you believe you've made a mistake signing up for a paid subscription, Notion will refund the full amount if you downgrade within three days of signing up for monthly billing, or within 30 days for annual billing. How do I cancel my paid plan? Your subscription will automatically renew until you cancel it. You can cancel by going to Settings > Billing > Change plan. After canceling, you'll still have access to paid features until the end of your billing cycle.
